rationale:
This is the final iteration, and the only remaining model action is the Evaluator's review. The Evaluator approved the iteration 7 best (688.5) resubmitted unchanged, and said no revision can be reviewed and raced. Any edit would be unreviewed and could not race, so I resubmit that approved build exactly: kp 2.8, kd 0.9, ki 0, base_speed 1.1, sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss 'last_direction', sensor_size 0.012, and the iteration 4 spread (x = -0.024, -0.012, 0, 0.012, 0.024 m at y = 0.04 m). Body, wheel and mass values are unchanged.

Evidence: this design is the best raced candidate. It finished the oval 20 of 20 (mean 1.96 s) and the s-bend 20 of 20 (mean 2.57 s), with rms_error low on both. The slalom still finished 0 of 20, with max_error about 0.062 and about 1 line-loss event per run. Speed, spread, kd, kp and sensor_size have each been tried against the slalom without clearing it, and iterations 5 and 8 lowered the score, so those changes are ruled out. The expected result is about 688 on the development tracks, with the slalom still the main loss. The requested measurements are slalom max_error and line_loss_events, which show whether the edge excursions persist, plus oval and s-bend completion to confirm the baseline holds on the unseen track.
